finding: RC4-07; the fourth recheck of the F2 contracts layer, benign column
case: The same eight census keys in a different order.
why: The pin is a SET and the comparison reads it as one. A byte comparison would refuse a reordering that changes nothing about which fields the census must carry, and a control that refuses harmless edits is one contributors learn to route around -- the argument this package makes at every other closed set it declares, made again here because the assertion is a different comparison in a different place.
